documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting Intimation For Board Meeting Intimation To Consider And Approve Standalone And Consolidated Un-Audited Financial Results For The Second Quarter And Half Year Ended On 30Th September, 2026 And Any Other Business
Appointment of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: AuSom Enterprise Limited reported a standalone revenue of Rs. 79,910.58 Lakhs and a net profit after tax of Rs. 2,000.94 Lakhs for the financial year 2025-26. The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Re. 1/- per equity share of Rs.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates achieving a gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs during the current year.
guidance.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts have been initiated.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated its wholly owned subsidiary Amazo Solar Power Private Limited and invested Rs. 100.00 Lakhs as equity share capital.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year the Company incorporated its Wholly own Subsidiary i.e. Amazo Solar Power Private Limited and invested Rs. 100.00 Lakhs as Equity Share Capital.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Re. 1/- per equity share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 29th May, 2026, have recommended a Final Dividend of Rs. 1/- (Rupee One only) per equity share of Rs.10/- (Rupees Ten only) each, aggregating Rs. 1,36,23,552 for the F.Y. 2025-26, subject to the approval of Members at the ensuing 42nd Annual General Meeting of the Company and deduction of tax at source, as required under the law.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board decided to retain the entire amount of profits for FY 2025-26 in retained earnings and transfer nothing to the General Reserve.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors has decided to retain the entire amount of profits for Financial Year 2025-26 in the retained earnings and not to transfer any amount to General Reserve.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a final dividend of Re. 1/- per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- each for the financial year 2024-2025.
capital_allocation.quote: To declare Final Dividend of Re. 1/- (10%) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- each, for the financial year 2024-2025.

capital_allocation.claim: An aggregate outstanding amount for giving loans under section 185 shall not exceed Rs. 3000.00 crores at any point of time.
capital_allocation.quote: giving loan(s) to an entity under the category ‘a person in whom any of the director of the company is interested’ as specified in the explanation to Sub-section 2(b) of the said Section, an aggregate outstanding amount at any point of time shall not exceeding Rs. 3000.00 crores (Rupees Three Thousand Crores only) on such terms and conditions including rate of interest, repayment etc. to be decided by the Board of Directors of the company in its interest from time to time.

capital_allocation.claim: Consent of members is accorded to give loans, guarantees, and make investments for an amount not exceeding Rs. 3000 Crores under Section 186.
capital_allocation.quote: (a) give any loan to any person or other body corporate; (b) give any guarantee or provide security in connection with a loan to any other body corporate or person; and (c) acquire by way of subscription, purchase or otherwise, the securities of any other body corporate from time to time in one or more tranches as the Board of Directors as in their absolute discretion deem beneficial and in the interest of the Company, for an amount not exceeding Rs. 3000 Crores (Rupees Three Thousand Crores Only)

management_commitments.claim: The company anticipates achieving a gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs during the current year.
management_commitments.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts have been initiated.

management_commitments.claim: The management stated that the target of gross turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs will definitely be achieved and necessary resources have been generated.
management_commitments.quote: The management of the Company is of the view that the target of gross turnover will definitely be achieved and necessary resources for the same have also been generated.

management_commitments.claim: The registered office of the company will be shifted to Zaveri House, Fourth Floor, Sanidhya, Bopal-Ambli Road, Ahmedabad, with effect from October 01, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: The Registered office of the Company will be shifted outside the local limits of the city, town or village i.e. from “11-B, New Ahmedabad Industrial Estate, Sarkhej Bavla Road, Village Moraiya, Ahmedabad – 382213, Gujarat, India to Zaveri House, Fourth Floor, Sanidhya, Opp Planet Landmark Hotel, Bopal- Ambli Road, Bopal, Ahmedabad – 380058, Gujarat, India” w.e.f. October 01, 2025, subject to approval of the members in Annual General Meeting of the Company.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
